acceptance_behavior: Discovery ignores every file under agent-system/runtime/ (worktrees, attempts, integration copies) even when a runtime file is a valid task-contract with the requested task id, and still returns the one real contract and its repository-relative path
When the same task id exists both as the real contract and as a copy under agent-system/runtime/worktrees/, the real contract is returned regardless of path sort order
Discovery behaves identically when no agent-system/runtime directory exists

When no contract exists for the task id outside agent-system/runtime/ (including when the only copy is under runtime), discovery raises the existing PlanningError whose message contains 'task contract file was not found'

Discovery does not list or open files under agent-system/runtime/ before filtering (prune the directory while walking, for example with os.walk and in-place pruning of dirnames), while still examining the remaining JSON files in sorted path order
intent.objective: Make ContextCompiler task-contract discovery ignore everything under agent-system/runtime/ and not traverse it (replan of DEMO-002 after a contract whose checks could not pass in the integration copy)
